title: 'The Young and the Restless' Spoilers Thursday, October 2: Audra Asks for a Second Chance from Nate; Jill Returns as Cane Urges Billy to Reconcile with Jill - NewsBreak
text:
By CP Bialois ,
12 hours ago ‘The Young and the Restless’ Spoilers here and we’re ready to keep things rolling with some fun spoilery goodies to share.
The episode for Thursday, October 2 looks like another fun character building one as mending relationships are the name of the game.
Sally Spectra (Courtney Hope) will update Audra Charles (Zuleyka Silver).
‘The Young and the Restless’ Spoilers Thursday, October 2: Audra Asks for a Second Chance from Nate; Jill Returns as Cane Urges Billy to Reconcile with Jill When Nate Hastings (Sean Dominic) arrives with Amy Lewis (Valarie Pettiford) and Lily Winters (Christel Khalil), Sally will urge her to try to reconcile with Nate.
It’ll take some effort, but Audra will ask to speak with Nate alone and she’ll admit she was wrong and beg to make things right.
Speaking of reconciliation, Billy Abbott (Jason Thompson) will confront Cane Ashby (Billy Flynn). He’ll want to know if he’s serious of just messing with everyone.
He’ll then push Cane to give up his plans and repair his relationship with his children.
Cane will counter it by saying he’ll do that if Billy does the same with Jill Abbott (Jess Walton) will arrive.
‘The Young and the Restless’ Spoilers for Thursday, October 2: Giving it another go ‘The Young and the Restless’ Spoilers have been waiting for Audra to try to make things right.
Her war with Kyle Abbott (Michael Mealor) is over, and we think watching his mistakes helped open her eyes.
Though part of us are surprised she didn’t go to Victor Newman (Eric Braeden) and try to get funding. It shows she’s grown as a character, and she’ll grow some more after taking Sally’s advice.
She’ll speak to Nate and apologize for what she did and ask if there’s anything she can do to earn back his trust.
We like them together, and it’s good to see Nate finding someone who appreciates him. Sure, Audra had to stumble and fall first, but she learned from it.
Image Credit: JPI Studios ‘The Young and the Restless’ Spoilers for Thursday, October 2: Jill’s back! Well, it looks like Billy is going to face his mother sooner rather than later. She’ll walk into his and Cane’s discussion claiming Billy hurt her in ways he can’t imagine.
We don’t doubt it, but it’s funny how her betraying Billy and cutting him off at the knees is an asterisk in her mind.
This should be an interesting scene as we’ll finally get to see Billy and Jill face off. We doubt Billy will want to talk to her, but maybe she’ll be able to stop him from leaving by apologizing.
Will Billy and Jill forgive each other or is there too much damage between them? Let us know in the comments below.
